How Does SCRIPE Enforce Enterprise Security Assurance & Platform Hardening Across All 19 Modules?

Long image

A

Answer

SCRIPE enforces 5-layer zero-trust defense across 19 backend modules, Next.js 16, and the CLI/CI toolchain. All 48 JSENTINEL findings, 26 net-new platform threats, all Category 5 backlog items, and 16 adversarial catches are closed in code.

  1. JSENTINEL 48/48 Reconciled: 13 confirmed live-drift findings closed (F02, F10, F11, F12-F17, F18, F28-F30), 31 bundle AST false positives disproved, and 4 managed-edge items bounded.
  2. 26 Net-New Threats & Category 5 Closed: 3 Critical (TH-API-01, TH-TEN-01, TH-TEN-02), 15 High, and 8 Medium threats are closed with V10.2.2 SSO CSRF, Redis DataProtection, and export FLS.
  3. 5-Layer Defense & Nonce CSP: Per-request 128-bit x-nonce CSP, /studio-preview and /dashboard-preview frame isolation, 6-pass CSS/SVG sanitization, postMessage origin-plus-source guard, and DNS-pinned SSRF handlers protect all boundaries.
  4. 4-Layer Proof & Zero Open Code Defects: 318 baseline plus 150 Wave 4 xUnit, 65 plus 31 Vitest, 11 live Chromium E2E (2f962e2a4), and 100/100 arch-check rules gate release.

Applies toSCRIPE-Backend (0ffde14c9) + SCRIPE-Frontend (2f962e2a4) + SCRIPE-CLI (268f169) + Root (d1c5fdb)

How Do the 5 Defense Layers, Nonce CSP, Tenant Isolation & DNS-Pinned SSRF Connect?

Diagram structure
  • Next.js Nonce & SSO BFF edge_csp
  • Sanitizer & sw.js v3 client_store
  • Kestrel & OIDC TX Guard api_ingress
  • 19-Mod Tenant, DSR & FLS tenant_fls
  • SSRF Pin, HMAC & DP Ring ssrf_crypto
  • CLI Arch-Check & 0-CVE ci_audit
  • edge_csp → client_store · x-nonce + Origin
  • edge_csp → api_ingress · SSO Hash + CSRF
  • api_ingress → tenant_fls · 4x9 PBAC + FLS
  • tenant_fls → ssrf_crypto · Outbox + FixedTime
  • ci_audit → api_ingress · BE/FE Rules + RE2

Click any highlighted node below to inspect how Next.js per-request nonce CSP, first-party SSO Login CSRF binding, Kestrel ingress policies, 19-module tenant/DSR/FLS guards, DNS-pinned SSRF handlers, and CI supply-chain gates interlock.

  1. Nonce CSP, Preview Framing & 14-Mode SSO BFF ↗

    src/proxy.ts mints a 128-bit x-nonce per request (ed2a07b3e), scopes SAMEORIGIN to /studio-preview and /dashboard-preview (84be82539), and binds ASVS V10.2.2 SSO Login CSRF via /api/auth/sso/{bind,consume-binding} (__Host-scripe_sso_nonce) and 14-mode /api/auth/session/establish (f93fc3533, be2b8783b, a2e951352).

  2. Sanitization, postMessage & sw.js v3 ↗

    6-pass sanitize-css.ts unescapes CSS L3 backslashes, strips control chars, and validates url(...) via sanitizeCssAssetUrl (84be82539), postmessage-security.ts verifies origin+source+schema (c036eb63e), /sw.js (scripe-v3-static-only) excludes "/", /api/*, and ?_rsc= (c7f4a2d3e), and session-cleanup-registry.ts purges storage (4595de933).

  3. Kestrel Ingress, /oidc/start TX & Sudo ↗

    Fail-closed FallbackPolicy (TH-API-02, 1c01a2843) protects all 198 controllers, GET /api/v1/auth/oidc/start sets __Host-scripe_oidc_tx (ExternalAuthTokenHash, ead632a6a, 9ca1916e9, ac5955af2), AssignPermissionsToRoleCommand enforces Sudo (ba2e85344), and QrLoginController / /2fa/verify scope OIDC cookies (c081fded9).

  4. 19-Module Tenant, DSR, Binary FLS & Domains ↗

    IDsrSubjectOwnershipVerifier isolates DSR requests (TH-TEN-01, b446a5575), DnsVerificationService requires _scripe-verify DNS TXT and fail-closed ITenantDomainRepository (TH-TEN-02, 9fffee765, ead632a6a), and binary exports enforce cell/DTO FLS shrinking FieldProjectionMiddleware.FileGuard.cs strictly to ["/compliance/dsr", "/downloads"] (1d8a856c1).

  5. DNS-Pinned SSRF, Webhooks & Redis DP Key-Ring ↗

    SsrfSafeHttpClientHandlerFactory and PrivateNetworkIpPolicy pin public IPs at connect time (31fbcc376, 88d921d3c), PaymobPaymentGateway and PayPal enforce CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals (TH-API-01, 8567de9c3), IdEncryptionOptions and VerificationSettings (CodeLength 6..10, 10m reset TTL) fail closed (ba2e85344, efcacddc8), and IDataProtectionProvider persists AES-256-GCM keys in Redis dataprotection:keys (8968bee3b).

  6. Static Security Rules, Fail-Closed Audit & RE2 ↗

    BE-040..042 and FE-035..036 enforce static security invariants (100/100, e5fbb64), scripe audit --json fails closed on malformed JSON (01fa10b), .gitleaks.toml uses pure Go RE2 syntax (d1c5fdb), and rootless Dockerfile / .dockerignore preserve appsettings.Production.json (cc11ad9e5, 268f169).

How Does the 4×9 Domain-Identity Assurance Flow Execute & What Governs External Production Cutover?

Every request is evaluated across 4 domain tiers (D1 Central Auth, D2 Tenant Subdomains, D3 Custom Domains, D4 Invalid/SQLi). It simultaneously enforces 9 identity tiers (I1 Protected Super Admin through I9 Suspended Accounts and Tenants).

Diagram structure
  • Browser / Playwright browser
  • Next.js Nonce & SSO BFF proxy
  • Studio Preview Guard studio
  • .NET 10 API Ingress api
  • Tenant, DSR & FLS Guard guard
  • browser → proxy · GET /login, /studio-preview, /dashboard-preview
  • proxy → browser · x-nonce CSP + DENY (SAMEORIGIN preview routes)
  • browser → proxy · POST /api/auth/sso/bind -> __Host-scripe_sso_nonce
  • browser → studio · Dispatch cross-origin postMessage spoofing payload
  • studio → browser · Reject mismatched event.origin / event.source / schema
  • browser → api · GET /oidc/start + POST /sso/handoff or DSR/Export
  • api → guard · ExternalAuthTokenHash + IDsrSubjectOwnershipVerifier + FLS
  • guard → api · 200 OK (bound) or 401/403/400 + tenant cache key
  • api → browser · Fail-closed response + Cache-Control: no-store

Release Readiness Verdict: Scoped GO (0 Open Code Defects) vs. Conditional NO-GO for External Cutover

Code, branch merge, pre-production, and local UAT hold a Scoped GO with 0 unresolved actionable engineering defects (0ffde14c9 Backend, 2f962e2a4 Frontend, 268f169 Dev-Tools, d1c5fdb root). All former Category 5 backlog items are CLOSED in code. That includes ASVS V10.2.2 SSO Login CSRF (ead632a6a, 9ca1916e9, ac5955af2, f93fc3533, be2b8783b, a2e951352, 2f962e2a4) and multi-replica AES-256-GCM Redis IDataProtectionProvider (8968bee3b). It also closes fail-closed IdEncryptionOptions, _scripe-verify/nxr_ C# defaults, and AssignPermissionsToRoleCommand Sudo (ba2e85344). VerificationSettings (CodeLength 6..10, PasswordResetExpirationMinutes = 10) startup validation (efcacddc8), binary export cell/DTO FLS (FieldProjectionMiddleware.FileGuard.cs shrunk to ["/compliance/dsr", "/downloads"] in 1d8a856c1), and scoped 2FA IsExternalSsoFlow / QrLoginController relay guards (c081fded9) are closed. Only intentional policies (Decision 2 EnableCentralNativeAndPasskeyMigration=false / WebAuthn:RpId=admin.scripe.org and ASVS V6.2.5 B2B password policy) remain by design. Unconditional live production cutover remains a Conditional NO-GO pending external cloud execution. Gate 1 requires Vercel deploy (>= 2f962e2a4) and Gate 2 requires auth.scripe.org Cloudflare DNS CNAME plus Vercel attachment. Gate 3 requires Railway deploy (>= 0ffde14c9) with ForwardedHeaders__ForwardLimit=2, ForwardedHeaders__KnownNetworks__0, GeoIp__OriginVerificationSecret, and optional DataProtection__EncryptionKey (falls back to HKDF-derived IdEncryption__Key). Gate 4 covers external IdP secrets outside git and post-deploy smoke verification.
